name: Nu Quantum
description: Nu Quantum is a Cambridge-based company developing photonic quantum networking technology to connect and scale quantum computers. The company's Qubit-Photon Interface and Entanglement Fabric technology enable modular, distributed quantum computing across multiple hardware platforms including trapped-ion and neutral-atom systems. Nu Quantum has raised over $70 million, including the largest Series A for quantum networking globally.

products.name: Qubit-Photon Interface
products.description: Photonic networking module that converts stationary qubits to flying photonic qubits for inter-node entanglement

products.name: Entanglement Fabric
products.description: Networking infrastructure enabling modular, distributed quantum computing across multiple hardware platforms

news.title: Nu Quantum Opens State-of-the-Art Trapped-Ion Qubit Networking Lab in Cambridge to Accelerate Distributed Quantum Computing
news.excerpt: Nu Quantum has opened a new trapped-ion quantum networking laboratory in Cambridge, UK, doubling its research infrastructure to accelerate distributed quantum computing. The facility will host a multi-node networking testbed to validate Nu Quantum's Qubit-Photon Interface technology for linking trapped-ion processors via scalable photonic networks.

news.title: Nu Quantum and Atom Computing sign MoU to network neutral-atom QPUs for utility-scale distributed quantum computing
news.excerpt: The transatlantic collaboration will integrate Atom Computing's neutral-atom systems with Nu Quantum's reconfigurable photonic networking hardware, targeting integrated photonics network switches and qubit-photon entanglement interfaces to reach GigaQuOp-scale cluster performance.
